description: Look up one of the 64 I Ching hexagrams by King Wen number (1-64), Chinese name, pinyin, or Wilhelm English name. Returns trigram composition, judgment (classical Chinese + Legge English translation), all six line texts, a plain-language meaning, and a link to the full page on thehexagrams.com.

hexagram.description: King Wen number 1-64, or name: "乾"/"qián"/"Force"/"The Creative".
